scope: Exactly 10 HF_W09_W14 TRAIN candidate raws, their SHA-bound same-scene B raws, and SHA-bound parent cosine-GRU raws. No Plant calls, TEST or VAL reads, tuning, or inertia reconstruction.
score_definition: Frozen score_full72 task_SO3_rad = sqrt(mean(theta^2)), theta = norm(Log(R_task^T R_actual)); the analysis reuses hf_task_budget_with_b_v2.task_error (SO(3) rotvec) and confirms every whole-record score against frozen score_raw and TRAIN24 summary.
paired_reference_check: For each scene, all three raw files have exactly equal 1 kHz time grids and reference acceleration/yaw arrays.

prior_unwindowed_estimates.interpretation: The prior finite-window FFT had no taper. The 0-2 s and 5-20 s values are historical spectral estimates, not task-score RMSE ratios.

methods.welch: Welch PSD summed across the three SO(3) log-vector components; Hann window; nperseg=2000 samples, 50% overlap (2 s segments, 0.5 Hz bins); run separately with per-segment constant/demean and linear detrending. Integrate bins 2<=f<=5 Hz and f>5 Hz.
methods.zero_phase_bandpass: Fourth-order Butterworth SOS, applied by sosfiltfilt to the full 20.001-sample trace, then score mean squared vector magnitude in each time slice. 2-5 Hz bandpass and >5 Hz high-pass are offline/noncausal; one-second edge guards are used at the record ends.
methods.aggregation: Equal-scene pooling: pooled RMSE = sqrt(mean of 10 per-scene band MSEs); also report per-scene sensitivity counts. Ratios above 1 mean the candidate has more band energy than B.

whole_0_20s.filter_type: Butterworth SOS; sosfiltfilt zero-phase; 2-5 Hz bandpass or >5 Hz high-pass

2_5s.filter_type: Butterworth SOS; sosfiltfilt zero-phase; 2-5 Hz bandpass or >5 Hz high-pass

5_20s.filter_type: Butterworth SOS; sosfiltfilt zero-phase; 2-5 Hz bandpass or >5 Hz high-pass

limitations: Welch reduces endpoint leakage but does not eliminate leakage; 0.5 Hz resolution and a 2 s Hann segment soften the 2 Hz/5 Hz boundaries.
The 2-5 s window has only two overlapping 2 s Welch segments, so its estimate has low averaging and should be read descriptively.
Zero-phase filtering uses future samples and is not deployable evidence. Its band edges are smooth, not brick-wall; the 5-20 s filtered score excludes [19,20] s to avoid end transients.
These offline error spectra diagnose recorded trajectories only. They do not prove causal controller improvement or identify physical mechanism.

conclusion.original_unwindowed_2_to_5_Hz_estimate: WITHDRAW_EXACT_MAGNITUDE; independent methods confirm candidate residual energy exceeds B
conclusion.original_5_to_20_s_near_parity_character: RETRACTED_AS_TOO_STRONG; independent ratios span 1.026 to 1.106, with candidate above B
conclusion.startup_attribution: The 0-2 s candidate error trace and gate-applied position input are identical to the parent cosine-GRU on all 10 scenes (gate=0); any candidate-vs-B startup spectral gap is inherited from the parent-vs-B trajectories, not introduced by N4 gating.
conclusion.causal_claim: No causal improvement claim is supported by these offline diagnostics.
